micro_benchmark.name: Matching Core Isolated (JMH)
micro_benchmark.scope: OrderBookManager.processOrder() — no Disruptor, no Kafka, no gRPC, no risk validation, no settlement

results.order_book_depth_note: 3 symbols, 100K orders each (300K total), prices randomized across a 10,000-deep spread
results.gc_note: Zero stop-the-world pauses during steady-state measurement

macro_benchmark_3min.name: Full Pipeline Replay — Binance BTC/USDT (3 minutes)
macro_benchmark_3min.scope: 4-stage LMAX Disruptor: Risk → Noop Journal → Matching → Settlement → Metrics
macro_benchmark_3min.scope_note: Kafka journaling DISABLED (NoopJournaler). Enabling Kafka would reduce throughput to Kafka round-trip speed.
macro_benchmark_3min.data_source: Binance WebSocket depth capture (BTC_USDT + ETH_USDT depth@100ms), looped

results.rejection_note: Balance-depletion driven under sustained stress; ~33% of events pass risk validation and reach the matching engine.
results.match_rate_note: Synthetic price distribution — captured depth deltas replayed as limit orders distributed across the full snapshot range, so most rest in the book without crossing the spread.

macro_benchmark_10min.name: Full Pipeline Replay — Binance BTC/USDT + ETH/USDT (10 minutes)
macro_benchmark_10min.scope: 4-stage LMAX Disruptor: Risk → Noop Journal → Matching → Settlement → Metrics
macro_benchmark_10min.data_source: Binance WebSocket depth capture (BTC_USDT + ETH_USDT depth@100ms), looped
macro_benchmark_10min.extrapolation_note: Extrapolated from the verified 3-minute run, which showed stable convergence (~407K ops/sec at pass 800+). A full 10-minute re-run has not been independently performed.
